summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting second quarter and half-year 2026 financial results. The filing contains routine operational and financial updates, including segment revenue, profitability, and cash flow figures. There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. The only notable item is an impairment charge related to a previously reported transfer of its eyewear business, but no new transaction is announced. This is a standard earnings release by a foreign private issuer.
